Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

dutchparl (development version)

  • Cabinet, election and party information can now come from REPDEM (new data releases, class voteListRepdem) or ParlGov (older releases). All functions work with both layouts.
  • addCabinetInfo() uses the new cabinetPeriods and voteCabinet tables for REPDEM data. caretaker is then 1 for every caretaker (demissionair) period: after resignation, after an election, and for interim cabinets. REPDEM data also get cabinet_id, cabinet_period_id, caretaker_reason and caretaker_parlgov. For ParlGov data, caretaker is taken from cabinetInfo as before.
  • addPartyInfo() matches cabinet parties on cabinet_id when available, ignores duplicate rows in partyElectionInfo, partyCabinetInfo and partyInfo, and sets cabinet_party and prime_minister to 0 for parties that hold seats but are not listed for the cabinet in office. REPDEM data also get support_party; includetype = "all" adds family_name, ches_lrgen, ches_lrecon and rile. Cabinet participation follows the same cabinet as addCabinetInfo(): voteCabinet/questionCabinet for votes and responders (date as fallback), the question date for questioners.
  • addCabinetInfo() for questionList objects no longer fails when cabinetInfo has no formal_resignation column.
  • filter() and subset() keep the voteCabinet, questionCabinet and questionText tables in sync. filter() on a voteList can filter on .table = "voteCabinet".
  • addCabinetInfo() for questionList objects uses the questionCabinet table of REPDEM data (cabinet at the date of the response).
  • examplevotes and examplequestions now use the REPDEM layout. The same votes and questions with ParlGov data are available as examplevotes_legacy and examplequestions_legacy. Text in the example data is ASCII only.

dutchparl 0.0.0.9009

  • addPartyInfo() and rice() no longer warn about unknown columns when the data are stored as tibbles.
  • Fixed na.rm = TRUE being passed to as.Date() instead of max() in addCabinetInfo() and addPartyInfo().
  • cosponsors() output is sorted with dplyr’s default C locale (dplyr >= 1.1.0), so upper-case names sort before lower-case names.
  • Requires tidyr >= 1.1.0 (single-value values_fill in pivot_wider()).
  • inst/CITATION now uses bibentry() instead of the deprecated citEntry().
  • Expanded the test suite and updated the GitHub Actions check workflow.

dutchparl 0.0.0.9007

  • Added a NEWS.md file to track changes to the package.
